import json
import shutil
from pathlib import Path

from makemarket.provenance import file_sha256, receipt

pull_path = Path('results/training/kaggle_padding_retry.json')
pull = json.loads(pull_path.read_text())
assert pull['status'] == 'outputs_retrieved'
out = Path('results/kaggle/padding-ablation-v2')
shutil.copytree('runs/kaggle_padding_retry_output', out, dirs_exist_ok=True)
pair = json.loads((out / 'pair_runtime.json').read_text())
record = {'provenance': receipt({'purpose': 'retain native and explicitly padded development prompt diagnostics'}, pair['model_revision']),
          'source': Path(__file__).read_text(), 'download_receipt': str(pull_path), 'pair_runtime': pair,
          'files_sha256': {str(p): file_sha256(p) for p in out.rglob('*') if p.is_file()}, 'stages': {},
          'interpretation': 'Fixed development prompts; no policy test or tuning. Native versus padded single sequence holds batch size fixed. Identical padded copies also vary batch size. All raw text, quotes, masks and failed/partial cases retained.'}
for stage in ('sft', 'grpo'):
    path = out / stage / 'inference_profile.json'
    if not path.exists():
        record['stages'][stage] = {'status': 'profile_not_saved'}
        continue
    p = json.loads(path.read_text())
    prior = json.loads(Path(f'results/kaggle/composition-ablation-v1/{stage}/inference_profile.json').read_text())
    assert p['states'] == prior['states']
    native = {case['state_index']: case['answers'][0]['quote'] for case in p['cases'] if case['name'] == 'native_single'}
    record['stages'][stage] = {'status': p['status'], 'cases': [
        {'name': case['name'], 'state_index': case['state_index'], 'input_shape': case['input_shape'],
         'left_pad_tokens': case['left_pad_tokens'], 'wall_seconds': case['wall_seconds'],
         'peak_allocated_bytes': case['peak_allocated_bytes'],
         'quote_changes_vs_native': sum(a['quote'] != native[case['state_index']] for a in case['answers']),
         'native_changed_vs_prior': native[case['state_index']] != prior['serial']['answers'][case['state_index']]['quote'],
         'parse_errors': sum(a['parse_error'] is not None for a in case['answers'])} for case in p['cases']]}
Path('results/training/kaggle_padding_retry_completion.json').write_text(json.dumps(record, indent=2) + '\n')
p = Path('results/training/kaggle_budget.json')
ledger = json.loads(p.read_text())
for session in ledger['sessions']:
    if session['kernel'] == pull['metadata']['id'] and session['version'] == 2:
        session.update(status='completed_outputs_retrieved' if pair['exit_codes'] == [0, 0] else 'partial_outputs_retrieved',
                       script_wall_seconds=pair['wall_seconds'], hours=pair['wall_seconds'] / 3600,
                       hours_basis='Downloaded script runtime; exact allocation billing boundaries unavailable.',
                       observed_complete_at=pull['polls'][-1]['at'], result_file=str(out / 'pair_runtime.json'))
p.write_text(json.dumps(ledger, indent=2) + '\n')
print(json.dumps({'runtime_seconds': pair['wall_seconds'], 'exit_codes': pair['exit_codes'], 'stages': record['stages']}, indent=2))
